subject.title: Add gated Claw discovery and API projection

question: Should ClawHub adopt the proposed experimental `claw` package family and its public discovery/API/CLI contract as part of the RFC-backed four-pull-request stack?
rationale: The patch introduces durable public schemas and discovery behavior, not a previously defined bug fix; tests can validate implementation but cannot determine whether this is the intended product boundary or release sequencing.

options.title: Sponsor the gated registry contract
options.body: Accept the experimental Claw package family and review the stacked schema, publication, discovery, and feed slices together after runtime proof is added.

options.title: Defer public discovery
options.body: Keep storage and validation work private until maintainers decide the permanent discovery and compatibility contract for Claws.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated registry contract
recommendation.body: Accept the experimental Claw package family and review the stacked schema, publication, discovery, and feed slices together after runtime proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest available cross-slice implementation context, though final product acceptance should come from a repository decision-maker.
